retry.422_activation_failed: Cloud records repair-required because lifecycle state or credentials are terminal
retry.503: Cloud retries while preflight, deployment configuration, or runtime infrastructure is unavailable

implementation_exception.scope: The v1 activation service is Fly-only and currently composes the existing Fly management command.
implementation_exception.reason: The staging fix must reuse the already-proven lifecycle and credential bootstrap without duplicating provider orchestration.
implementation_exception.risk: The API service is coupled to Fly-specific settings until activation composition moves behind a provider-neutral service.
implementation_exception.mitigation: Keep the endpoint bearer-authenticated, retain strict workspace and receipt validation, and move provider orchestration behind the existing provider-neutral workspace seam before introducing another provider.
implementation_exception.revisit_condition: Before adding a second workspace provider or promoting the activation contract beyond Fly-backed Allies environments.
